title: Towards Faithful Agentic XAI: A Verification Method and an Open-World Benchmark for Better Model Faithfulness
abstract: arXiv:2605.27879v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) helps users interpret model behavior and identify potential faults. Agentic XAI systems use Large Language Models (LLMs) to make explanations more accessible through natural-language interaction, but they can also produce plausible yet unfaithful explanations. This risk arises because unreliable XAI outputs for complex models can be amplified by LLMs and mislead users. We propose Faithful Agentic XAI (FAX), a verification method that improves the faithfulness of Agentic XAI explanations. FAX decomposes draft explanations into claims and tests them with inherently faithful tools that query the target model directly, filtering unsupported or contradicted claims before final generation. We also introduce CRAFTER-XAI-Bench, an open-world reinforcement learning benchmark with complex policies, diverse goals, and challenging scenarios for assessing model-specific faithfulness. translated_title: 迈向忠实智能体可解释AI（XAI）：一种验证方法与开放世界基准，以提升模型忠实性
translated_abstract: 可解释AI（XAI）帮助用户解释模型行为并识别潜在故障。智能体XAI（Agentic XAI）系统利用大型语言模型（LLM）通过自然语言交互使解释更易于理解，但也可能产生看似合理却不忠实的解释。这种风险源于复杂模型不可靠的XAI输出可能被LLM放大并误导用户。我们提出了忠实智能体XAI，这是一种验证方法，可提高智能体XAI解释的忠实性。FAX将草拟的解释分解为多个声明，并使用能直接查询目标模型的内在忠实工具对其进行检验，在最终生成前过滤掉缺乏支持或相互矛盾的声明。我们还引入了CRAFTER-XAI-Bench，这是一个开放世界强化学习基准，具有复杂策略、多样化目标和富有挑战性的场景，用于评估模型特定的忠实性。在CRAFTER-XAI-Bench上，FAX提高了模拟……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出FAX验证方法，通过将解释分解为声明并用直接查询目标模型的忠实工具加以检验过滤，同时引入CRAFTER-XAI-Bench开放世界强化学习基准，从而提升智能体XAI解释的忠实性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FAX, a verification method that decomposes draft explanations into claims and validates them with inherently faithful tools that directly query the target model, and introduces CRAFTER-XAI-Bench, an open-world reinforcement learning benchmark, to improve the faithfulness of Agentic XAI explanations.
